feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because IT Secure LLC is outside ForgeX's target segment of home-service contractors and already provides IT management, data analytics, and AI automation services in-house.

aiDelivery.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended. Furthermore, IT Secure LLC explicitly positions its brand against automated phone/support bots ('no scripts, no robots') while offering its own AI and automation services to clients.

risks.description: Pitching basic automation services to a Managed Service Provider that already sells AI solutions, cloud management, and business data analysis would be misaligned with ForgeX's home-service contractor focus.

assumptions: The website publishes no service prices (the /pricing/ link returns HTTP 404), and the business is not a fit for ForgeX services.

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Business identity, Meridian location, service areas, core MSP offerings, client dashboard link, and positioning statements.
Company background, remote support and systems management focus, and statement of over 40 years of experience.
Detailed list of primary and support services, including RMM, MDM, Business Data Analysis, Help Desk Support, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Solutions.
Business phone number, text support number, and web contact form verification.
MSP industry classification and partnerships with Microsoft, Apple, and Google.
Consultation booking page and scheduling script references.
Legal entity name (IT Secure LLC), Meridian street address, WePay payment processing usage, and automated SMS/MMS platform capabilities.

limitations: The /pricing/ page linked across the site returns an HTTP 404 error, so no service pricing is publicly available.
The website does not list employee headcount or name any owners, executives, or managers outside of a customer testimonial (which is excluded under ForgeX evidence rules).
Email addresses on the website are obfuscated behind Cloudflare email protection links.

qualification.rationale: IT Secure LLC is a B2B Managed Service Provider (MSP) offering IT support, cybersecurity, cloud services, business data analysis, and AI automation solutions. It falls outside ForgeX's target segment of owner-led home-service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical) and already owns and sells technology and automation solutions.
